text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I was heading to a spot with a 
beautiful sunset view with Mejiro Ryan and 
the others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Rumor has it that it's breathtakingly 
beautiful! Hehehe, I'm really looking 
forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"The sun usually torments us so, but just 
for today, I feel I could come to adore 
it."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha, totally! Come on, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's breathtaking... I feel like I'm being 
drawn in.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... No way, I can't do it...! It's way 
too embarrassing...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Since Palmer-sama took the time to teach 
me, I really want to take a picture 
together~~!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"What a coincidence! You two are here 
too."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, my, perfect timing~. Ryan-oneesama, 
let's take a photo together too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Like thiiis... Let's take a photo with a 
heart pose♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My, isn't that lovely? Hehe, how 
wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm saying it's 
embarrassing...! That kind of stuff is 
just too much for Ryan and me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, let's take a picture, Dober. Come on, 
do the heart pose!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh!? What's wrong, Ryan!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Making memories, making memories! Since 
we're on an uninhabited island and all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's true, but... Even so, still—ugh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Let's take that first step. Right now, 
it's just the two of us. This is our 
chance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Now's my chance... Mmm—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Then... maybe I'll give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let's make it a wonderful picture~~. 
Ehehe.
choice_data_list: Well then, leave the camera to me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Alright, ready everyone? Say cheese!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The four Umamusume formed a giant heart 
shape, their faces flushed so bright red 
they outshone the setting sun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer, just the two of us. Could 
we take a photo together too?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Let's recreate a scene from a manga, 
something super duper cute...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't that splendid? Allow me to 
take the picture.
choice_data_list: Cutely, huh... I wonder if I can do it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: This is a challenge, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
With a gentle push forward, there's 
nothing that can't be done. There's always 
someone who will accept you, no matter 
what.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"That gradually turns into confidence. 
It's small, but... enough to give me 
courage!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Who was it that taught me that again?
choice_data_list:
Right, that's how it was... All right, 
let's take the photo!
That's right... All right, let's take it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's make it super cute! 
Ready, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During our days spent on the deserted 
island, the smile on Mejiro Ryan's face 
right next to me was without a doubt her 
most radiant yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beneath the moonlight, Mejiro Ryan's 
sparkling smile showed on the smartphone 
screen.
choice_data_list: It's a shame you can only see it here.
It's a pity you can only see it here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. For now, yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...I hope the day comes when I can lay 
myself bare outside of this deserted 
island, too."
choice_data_list:
Yeah... Let's take our time and give it a 
shot.

Yeah... Let's take our time with this 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...So that someday, I can take 
another step forward—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Please give me a push forward, Trainer.
